title: Candidate ops daypack — Priya Shah 2026-03-13
content:
Morning quick hits:
- 9:00am standup with hiring managers (Hannah + Miguel) — confirm panel for SDE-IC4
- 9:30am: confirm room + zoom for onsite loop (A/C test) — tell facilities if >6 ppl
- 10:00am: screen follow-ups (see list below)

Candidate follow-ups (PRIORITY order):
1) Maya Chen — Data Engineer (referral)
   - last touch: 2026-03-11 (phone screen). Wants onsite Mon/Tue next week.
   - TODO: send calendar options TUE/WED 10-3 PT, ask about relocation timeline, cc hiring mgr (Hannah)
   - template to send: "Hi Maya — enjoyed our convo. Are any of these slots good? If relocation is still TBD we can discuss remote-first options. — Priya"
   - status: waiting on candidate

2) Carlos R. Morales — SDE IC4
   - last touch: 2026-03-12 (homework completed)
   - blockers: comp approval pending (Miguel), need confirmation on take-home rubric
   - TODO: ping Miguel + DM in #recruiting-hiring, add Jira RECRUIT-4123 note
   - note: escalate comp if no reply by EOD

3) Priya Singh — Product Designer
   - scheduled: 2026-03-14 11:00am PT (pre-onsite)
   - prework: portfolio + design exercise received — reviewer assignment: Emily
   - TODO: confirm panelers (design lead + PM)

Reschedules & calendar housekeeping:
- Reschedule Samir K. (Sourcer) 1:1 — moved to 2026-03-16 2pm
- Block "interview buffer" 30m after each onsite loop today (3:30pm, 5:00pm)
- Check OOO calendar: Hannah off 2026-03-18 to 20; need to reroute approvals

Interview logistics checklist (short):
- Zoom links: create meeting, add passcode, put in invite and candidate email
- Panel bios: paste 2-line bios in invite
- Interview packet: attach rubric + role one-pager
- Travel: for onsite offers, hold provisional hotel (finance OK?) — flag to ops

Message templates (copy-paste):
- "Thanks for taking the interview prep. Quick note: please bring a govt ID and arrive 10 min early. We'll be using Room A on 3rd floor."
- "Hi {candidate}, thanks for the update. Confirming {time slot}. If anything changes please let me know. — Priya"

Open items / blockers:
- Background check vendor needs candidate DOB for Priya Singh — ask candidate in follow-up (CONFIDENTIAL)
- Miguel hasn't approved SDE IC4 comp bracket — what is allowable flex?
- Need final job description for Data Eng role (Hannah to share link)

End-of-day wrap (my quick rubric):
- 80% candidates replied -> push scheduling; less than 80% -> send gentle nudge
- Any new offer paperwork must be submitted to finance by EOD if hiring mgr verbal ok

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep follow-ups concise (1-2 bullets). Use calendar poll only for >3 slots.
- Save "common rejections" phrases for template doc (conserve tone)

Related links:
- Hiring pipeline board: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RECRUIT-BOARD
- Interview guide (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Interview+Guide+IC+Track
- Candidate email thread: slack thread linked in #recruiting-hiring

Quick metrics snapshot (manual):
- Open reqs: 14
- Candidates in pipeline: 48
- Screens completed this week: 9
- Offers extended YTD: 12

Bottom line / today priorities:
- Ping Miguel on comp approval (SDE IC4)
- Send Maya slots + confirm Maya remote/relocation
- Prep onsite packet for Priya Singh

Random note: try to standardize "candidate friendly" calendar titles — e.g., "Redwood Interview — {Role} — {Candidate}" to avoid confusion.

-- Priya
